comparison.objective: Start a pendulum and brake it on its third swing while stabilizing its stand; no mechanical damping adjustment.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stand holding, timed release, swing counting, and button pressing; shares control actuation and observation only, not key/collar/setscrew work.
comparison.success_condition: Brake once on the third return, avoid touching the moving bob, then withdraw; numeric timing tolerance is not stated.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is temporal interception of oscillation, not iterative tuning and physical locking of a damper.
